Instagram posting schedule for beginners: 2 reels, 1 carousel and stories 3 days a week is enough to start growing.

Day 4 of growing a new Instagram account from zero. Before you copy anyone's posting schedule, count the hours you can really give to content each week.

Few hours? Monday a carousel, Wednesday and Friday a reel, stories on the days in between. More time? Add a Sunday reel and post stories daily.

Consistency beats volume: a schedule you keep for three months grows an account faster than a daily plan you quit in week two.

Save this and plan your week from it.
